description: This file defines the CommonFixture class used in unit testing, specifically for storage tests related to relational storage in the Orleans framework. It manages storage providers, handles setup and environment invariants, and provides methods to retrieve storage providers based on invariants.

classes.name: CommonFixture
classes.description: A fixture class used in unit tests for setting up and managing storage providers within Orleans relational storage test environments.

methods.name: GetStorageProvider
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a storage provider based on the given storage invariant, ensuring environment invariants are satisfied before provision.
